lead.t: Second: 24–26 weeks — Assess maternal and fetal well-being; exclude pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) and anaemia; give preventive measures; review the birth and emergency plan; advise and counsel

snip.t: Second: 24–26 weeks — Assess maternal and fetal well-being; exclude pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) and anaemia; give preventive measures; review the birth and emergency plan; advise and counsel
Premature delivery can be the result of preterm labor and preterm premature rupture of the membranes (PPROM), or it can be due to maternal indications (eg, pregnancy-induced hypertension).
